articles.summary: BOSTON, July 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aura Biosciences, Inc. (NASDAQ: AURA), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision therapies for solid tumors designed to preserve organ function, today announced the appointment of Jeremy Bender, Ph.D., M.B.A., to its Board of Directors.
articles.title: Aura Biosciences Announces Appointment of Jeremy Bender, Ph.D., M.B.A., to Board of Directors
